notes: Inputs are already loaded Data; fresh ImageSource for every timed decode.
Concurrent batches run before per-page measurements; firstSeconds is not process-cold startup.
A separate reference buffer remains alive during repeated per-page decodes and cache work.
Batch outputs all remain alive until the end; latencies exclude queueing before a worker starts.
Cache reloads include file open and decode, using recently written files (warm filesystem).
Cache writes include encoding, file writing and atomic rename, without explicit fsync.
Archive extraction, GPU upload and UI rendering are excluded.
0.12.0 is a local experimental build; published production dependency remains 0.11.2.
Different native compiler/build settings are not isolated from version differences.
